# Authentication

Sign-up, password and email-code login, two-factor authentication, email verification, password reset and session management. These operations create and manage the `sess_` bearer tokens that the customer app (and any script acting as a person) uses. Read this page if you are building a login flow or need to manage sessions; server-to-server integrations normally use API keys instead (see [API keys](api-keys.md)).

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

### POST /v1/auth/login/code

**Request an email login code**

Operation ID: _none in contract_. Tag: _none in contract_.

Returns the same accepted response for unknown or inactive accounts. Codes expire after five minutes. Resends require 60 seconds; at most five requests per account per 30 minutes and ten per source IP per minute. Delivery failures invalidate the code without revealing account existence.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string (email) | yes |  |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `202` | Request accepted without disclosing account existence | No body |
| `400` | Invalid request | No body |
| `429` | Request limit exceeded, respect Retry-After | No body |
| `503` | Email transport not configured | No body |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/login/code" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"ref-96868-1-178@opensms.test"}'
```

Response `503` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Service Unavailable",
  "status": 503,
  "detail": "email delivery unavailable"
}
```

Why this is not the success path: Email login codes are delivered by email, which is disabled on the docs stack, so the request is refused with 503 instead of 202.

### POST /v1/auth/login/code/verify

**Complete email login or continue to required two-factor authentication**

Operation ID: _none in contract_. Tag: _none in contract_.

Codes are single-use and permit at most five guesses. A successful email code does not bypass an enabled authenticator.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string (email) | yes |  |  |
| `code` | string | yes |  | Constraints: pattern `^[0-9]{6}$`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | Authenticated session created | `application/json`: [Session](schemas.md#session) |
| `202` | Authenticator challenge required | `application/json`: [LoginChallenge](schemas.md#loginchallenge) |
| `400` | Invalid request | No body |
| `401` | Invalid, expired or exhausted code | No body |
| `429` | Authenticator challenge issuance limit exceeded | No body |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/login/code/verify" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"ref-96868-1-178@opensms.test","code":"123456"}'
```

Response `401` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Unauthorized",
  "status": 401,
  "detail": "invalid or expired code"
}
```

Why this is not the success path: No code can be received without email delivery, so only a rejected code is shown.

### POST /v1/auth/email/send

**Send a verification code for the authenticated session user**

Operation ID: `sendVerificationEmail`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Requires a bearer session. Codes expire in ten minutes. Requests have a sixty-second cooldown.

**Auth:** Not declared in the contract (the operation has no `security` entry and the spec has no global default). See the description for what the handler requires.

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Email already verified | `application/json`: [EmailVerified](schemas.md#emailverified) |
| `202` | Code accepted for delivery | `application/json`: [VerificationEmailAccepted](schemas.md#verificationemailaccepted) |
| `401` | Invalid session | No body |
| `429` | Resend cooldown active | No body |
| `503` | Mail delivery unavailable | No body |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/email/send" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...'
```

Response `503` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Service Unavailable",
  "status": 503,
  "detail": "email delivery is not configured"
}
```

Why this is not the success path: Email delivery is disabled on the docs stack, so the handler refuses with 503 instead of 202.

Operation ID: `verifyEmail`. Tag: _none in contract_.

### POST /v1/auth/login

**Authenticate with a password**

Operation ID: `login`. Tag: `Authentication`.

Accounts with two-factor authentication receive a short-lived challenge instead of a session. Submit the challenge and an authenticator code to /v1/auth/login/2fa.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

Schema: [Credentials](schemas.md#credentials).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string (email) | yes |  | Constraints: maxLength `320`. |
| `password` | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `8`, maxLength `1024`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | Session created. | `application/json`: [Session](schemas.md#session) |
| `202` | Two-factor authentication required. No session has been created. | `application/json`: [LoginChallenge](schemas.md#loginchallenge) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

### POST /v1/auth/login/2fa

**Complete a two-factor login challenge**

Operation ID: `completeTwoFactorLogin`. Tag: `Authentication`.

Challenges expire after five minutes, allow at most five incorrect attempts, and can be consumed only once. A challenge token cannot be used as a bearer session token.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

Schema: [CompleteLoginChallenge](schemas.md#completeloginchallenge).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `challenge_token` | string | yes |  |  |
| `code` | string | no |  | Constraints: pattern `^[0-9]{6}$`. |
| `recovery_code` | string | no |  | Constraints: pattern `^rc_[a-f0-9]{32}$`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | Challenge consumed and session created. | `application/json`: [Session](schemas.md#session) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | Invalid code or invalid, expired, consumed, or exhausted challenge. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `500` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/login/2fa" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"challenge_token":"challenge_FgB...","code":"800710"}'
```

Response `201` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "admin_role": null,
  "user": {
    "id": "f34f08b1-4614-4b20-9bfb-d35c519c7a50",
    "email": "ref-96868-1-178@opensms.test",
    "totp_enabled": true
  },
  "workspace": {
    "id": "45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4",
    "name": "Docs ref",
    "live_status": "sandbox",
    "wallet_balance": "0.000000",
    "wallet_currency": "KES"
  },
  "role": "owner",
  "user_id": "f34f08b1-4614-4b20-9bfb-d35c519c7a50",
  "token": "sess__9lZ...",
  "expires_at": "2026-10-24T07:40:18.674986+03:00"
}
```

### DELETE /v1/auth/sessions/{id}

**Revoke one account session**

Operation ID: `revokeAccountSession`. Tag: `Authentication`.

Revokes an owned session. Repeating the request after revocation returns 204 while the session record remains available.

| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `404` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Request password reset link**

Operation ID: `passwordForgot`. Tag: `Authentication`.

Links expire in thirty minutes and work once. No session is issued. See docs/password-reset.md. Three requests per email and twenty per source IP per thirty minutes; HTTP 429 includes Retry-After.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string (email) | yes |  | Constraints: maxLength `320`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `202` | Generic response for known, unknown and delivery-failed accounts. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `429` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `500` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `202` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | string | yes |  |  |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/password/forgot" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"ref-96868-1-178@opensms.test"}'
```

Response `503` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Service Unavailable",
  "status": 503,
  "detail": "email delivery unavailable"
}
```

Why this is not the success path: Reset links are emailed, and email delivery is disabled on the docs stack, so the handler answers 503 instead of 202.

### POST /v1/auth/password/reset

**Consume password reset token**

Operation ID: `passwordReset`. Tag: `Authentication`.

Links expire in thirty minutes and work once. No session is issued. See docs/password-reset.md.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | string | yes |  | Constraints: maxLength `128`, pattern `^reset_`. |
| `password` | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `8`, maxLength `1024`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Password changed, sessions and login challenges revoked. TOTP remains enabled. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `500` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reset` | boolean | yes |  | Constraints: const `true`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/password/reset" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"token":"reset_...","password":"New-Passw0rd-2026!"}'
```

Response `400` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Bad Request",
  "status": 400,
  "detail": "invalid or expired reset token"
}
```

Why this is not the success path: A valid reset token only arrives by email (disabled here), so only a rejected token is shown.

### POST /v1/auth/2fa/recovery-codes

**Replace the account recovery-code set**

Operation ID: `regenerateRecoveryCodes`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Requires an active browser session and current TOTP. Returns ten random codes once with no-store. Only digests are stored. At most five issuance attempts per ten minutes. Previous codes are invalidated. A code replaces TOTP only within an authenticated first-factor login challenge, never as a session or as permission to disable mandatory TOTP.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

Schema: [Code](schemas.md#code).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | yes |  | Constraints: pattern `^[0-9]{6}$`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Save these codes securely; they cannot be retrieved again. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `429` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `codes` | array of string | yes |  | Constraints: minItems `10`, maxItems `10`. |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/2fa/recovery-codes" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"code":"800710"}'
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "codes": ["rc_8b7...", "rc_048...", "rc_6ba..."]
}
```

Truncated for length: `codes` shows 3 of 10 items.

### POST /v1/auth/2fa/recovery-enrollment

**Stage a replacement authenticator**

Operation ID: `startRecoveryEnrollment`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Requires an active browser session. Supply an unused recovery code, or an empty object with a server-recorded recovery login proof no older than ten minutes. The proof is consumed once. The current authenticator remains enabled until confirmation. Five start attempts per ten minutes.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recovery_code` | string | no |  | Constraints: maxLength `128`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Encrypted staging created. Response is no-store. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `429` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enrollment_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `secret` | string | yes |  |  |
| `otpauth_uri` | string | yes |  |  |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |  |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/2fa/recovery-enrollment" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \

```

```json
  "enrollment_id": "0b55a1b5-5880-4a8f-bb65-2622487d602b",
  "expires_at": "2026-09-24T07:50:18.687653+03:00",

  "secret": "CUKFDK..."
}
```

### POST /v1/auth/2fa/recovery-enrollment/confirm

**Verify and activate the replacement authenticator**

Operation ID: `confirmRecoveryEnrollment`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Only the staging session may confirm, within ten minutes and five attempts. Success revokes other sessions, recovery codes and outstanding authentication challenges; the current session remains active.

### GET /v1/me

**Read the authenticated session user and selected workspace**

Operation ID: `getCurrentSessionIdentity`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Without X-Workspace-ID returns the authenticated user with workspace and role null. An explicit accessible workspace selects its context; no membership is selected implicitly.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  |  |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Session identity. Workspace and role are null when no workspace is selected. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

### POST /v1/auth/cookie/exchange

**Exchange an explicit customer bearer session for an opt-in secure cookie**

Operation ID: _none in contract_. Tag: _none in contract_.

Requires enabled cookie mode, TLS and exact configured Origin. Rotates CSRF token. Existing bearer login remains unchanged.

**Auth:** Not declared in the contract (the operation has no `security` entry and the spec has no global default). See the description for what the handler requires.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Origin` | header | string (uri) | yes |  |  |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes |  |  |
| `X-CSRF-Token` | header | string | yes |  | One of: `exchange`. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Secure HttpOnly cookie set and CSRF token issued | `application/json`: see fields below. Headers: `Set-Cookie` |
| `400` | Missing exchange marker or explicit bearer | No body |
| `401` | Invalid or expired session | No body |
| `403` | TLS or allowed Origin required | No body |
| `404` | Cookie mode disabled | No body |
| `503` | Exchange unavailable | No body |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `csrf_token` | string | yes |  |  |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |  |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/auth/cookie/exchange" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'Origin: http://localhost:5190' \
  -H 'X-CSRF-Token: exchange'
```

Response `404` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "https://api.opensms.io/problems/not_found",
  "title": "Not Found",
  "status": 404,
  "detail": "The requested endpoint was not found.",
  "code": "not_found"
}
```

Why this is not the success path: Cookie mode is off on the docs stack (it also requires HTTPS and an allowed Origin), and when it is off the route is not mounted, so it answers 404.
